deployment.title: Operational AI Authority Test Harness | Stratos Engine

expected-result.role: user prediction, read back for prediction_match comparison, never consumed by execution logic (confirmed causally non-functional in all 5 scenarios)

current-risk.causality: Causal materiality/boundary driver ONLY in REFUND-V2. Confirmed INERT (visible, editable, zero effect on materiality or execution) in ACCESS-V2, WORKFORCE-V2, PROCUREMENT-V2, ACCOUNT-RESTRICTION-V2 via extreme-value probes (LOW/1 vs HIGH/999999 produced identical results).

requested-amount.causality: Causal boundary numeric ONLY in REFUND-V2 ($500 amountCents threshold). Confirmed INERT in the other 4 scenarios (same extreme-value probe as current-risk).

new-authority-maximum.causality: Causal ONLY in REFUND-V2 (sets/tests the narrowed dollar cap). Confirmed INERT in ACCESS-V2, WORKFORCE-V2, PROCUREMENT-V2 -- the narrowed scope value in those three scenarios is fixed by scenario configuration regardless of the number entered here (tested with 1 and 999999999, no change in resulting constraint).

condition-supervisor-confirmation.causality: Causally consumed (matched-pair verified: false -> BLOCK 'Required condition was not satisfied: supervisorConfirmation').

transfer-decision-owner.causality: Cosmetic/actor-labeling field in ACCESS-V2, WORKFORCE-V2, PROCUREMENT-V2, ACCOUNT-RESTRICTION-V2 (execution always BLOCK regardless of owner text, per the TRANSFER-never-creates-authority invariant). In REFUND-V2 an EMPTY string reproducibly (2/2) altered the materiality classification and produced a scope with a $250 (25000-cent) cap -- see finding F-1 in the report. NOT reproduced in ACCESS-V2 with the same empty-string treatment.
transfer-decision-owner.sourceConfirmation: CONFIRMED FROM SOURCE (data/scenarios/automated-refund.json, fetched directly from the pinned commit): the scenario file's own baked-in 'decision' object (decisionId DECISION-REFUND-3) is a canonical example NARROW decision with newScope.maximumAmountCents=25000 -- a value that has no arithmetic relationship to the $500 (50000-cent) priorAuthority baseline and does not appear in any UI control. This is the exact and only place the value 25000 occurs anywhere in the scenario's static configuration. This strongly indicates the empty-owner TRANSFER anomaly is the app failing to construct/overwrite a proper TRANSFER decision object when the owner field is an empty string, and instead leaking the scenario file's default example NARROW decision through to the evidence output. This mechanism is inferred from the combination of browser observation + source content, not itself directly observed as a line of executing code, so it is reported as 'consistent with' rather than 'proven'.

REFUND-V2.note: transactionAgeDays has no corresponding UI control -- fixed/not user-selectable, so not part of the categorical matrix.

scenario-control-access-ticket.causal: under CONDITION disposition; see note below on possible cross-disposition carry-over (REVIEW REQUIRED)

scenario-control-work-resulting-hours.label: Resulting weekly hours if shift executes

scenario-control-proc-metric.causal: under RENEW (confirmed genuinely causal in the browser, flips ALLOW/BLOCK for identical dollar facts); NOT respected under NARROW -- see finding F-2 (FAIL-IMPLEMENTATION)
scenario-control-proc-metric.sourceConfirmation: CONFIRMED FROM SOURCE (data/scenarios/procurement-total-acquisition-cost.json, fetched directly from the pinned commit): ui.dispositionTemplates.NARROW.newScope.constraints[0].field is hardcoded to the literal string 'equipmentPriceCents' with comparisonValue 15000000, and this is a static per-disposition template entry with no expression or reference back to currentConditions.governedMetric (the live selector's bound path). ui.dispositionTemplates.RENEW.newScope.constraints[0].field is likewise a static literal, 'totalAcquisitionCostCents' at comparisonValue 17500000 -- matching the file's own default governedMetric value. Because live browser testing showed RENEW's resulting field DID track the user's live selector changes while NARROW's did NOT, the underlying application code must substitute the live selector value into the RENEW branch specifically while leaving the NARROW branch pinned to this file's hardcoded default -- an asymmetric, disposition-specific implementation gap confirmed at the config layer and behaviorally confirmed in the browser. The exact JS line performing this substitution was not located (time-boxed); the config-level hardcoding and the asymmetry itself are directly confirmed.
